invariants: All509 ordered complete actual Source observations match six groups: real registry/filesystem mutations, read tool/result/replay, image routing/store/gates, read windows/metadata, sandbox approval choreography and contextual diffs.

Source pin, runtime, tracked inputs, observer/case bytes and the actual diff dependency are guarded; own Python3.8.10 imports equal an independently approved closure with complete candidate inputs checked before and after.

Read validates positive-integer caps, scans exact total lines through sync/async delivery, preserves UTF16 truncation including lone surrogates, caps complete rendered lines by UTF8 bytes, and emits one authoritative observation after successful read or an absent observation for a missing target.
Real read stats once. Write/edit use the observed basis without tool-layer stat; successful mutation refreshes observation and preserves exact disk bytes.

Read results expose canonical numbered text and continuation/end markers, structured metadata and strict replay narrowing. Contextual diff cards retain every applied hunk with three context lines and omit patch-only newline markers.
Image execution uses the current routed model, actual attachment service and capability/read-policy checks; mounted store epochs reversibly control tool availability.

Sandbox escalation fields are advertised only for a confining backend; paired arguments, strictly wider mode, live actor/approval, exact audit request and returned one-shot policy are required. Standing policy and provider errors retain ownership and precise denial/remedy messages.

No paths, errors, text, timestamps, roles or identities are substituted. Only same-valued finite integer JSON numbers share numeric representation; booleans, fractions, nonfinite values and UTF16 surrogate content are not collapsed.
Partial, changed, foreign, duplicated, skipped, failed or missing consumer/Source/import/mandatory/extracted evidence is refused. Focused qualification cannot replace a clean complete release.
identity: Exact509 ordered fs_values_oracle.NAMES. Actual controlled filesystem workspace is declared by Source and reused by Root/own/extracted observers; literal absolute public paths are retained.
ownership: Tool plugin owns reversible registrations; backend owns atomic file mutation; policy owns observed basis; attachment provider owns durable image bytes; each probe owns its recorded temporary filesystem fixture.
ordering: Six ordered groups and literal internal traces, output blocks, line numbers, schemas and hunks.
errors: Actual FsError codes and model remedies, image/gate errors, replay refusal and approval outcomes retain literal text and field presence.
cancellation: Image pre-abort and sandbox cancellation are compared; broader overlapping transport/workflow races remain separate parent work.
adaptation: Python3.8 standard-library UTF16/UTF8 accounting and Myers line-diff port replace JavaScript string/Buffer operations and diff dependency. The existing attachment provider performs image validation; no new runtime dependency is introduced.
open_questions: Complete profile/browser/policy composition and arbitrary extension-owned filesystem/attachment ABI remain wider parent qualification.
